subtasks: Place the toy car lengthwise in the back of the box with its front pointing left, leaving room for the other objects.
Use the left gripper to pick up the staged red toy car at the front of the table and place it in the back row of the box, front pointing left. Withdraw the right hand.
Use the left hand to position the empty box in the middle of the table within reach of both arms, upright with its long edges running left to right.
Pack the white shoe lengthwise along the back wall inside the centered box, with its toe pointing left, leaving the front row free for the car.
Place the staged red toy car front-left in the empty back row behind the shoe inside the box, keeping its long axis parallel to the box.
Pick up the hammer by its handle, turn it around until its black mallet head points left, and place it lengthwise fully inside the box between the shoe and car.

Pack the white electric toothbrush from the right tabletop into the box. Turn it lengthwise with its small brush head pointing left and its thick handle pointing right. Release it fully inside on stable support, then open both hands and return both arms to their starting poses.
